results.title: The Museum of Naive Art in Mazotos
results.description: In November 2023, the official opening of the museum took place in his native village of Mazotos. Costas Argirou was born in 1917 in the village of Mazotos, into a peasant family. After completing seven years of schooling, he started farming and herding cattle.
